name: Four Seasons Hotel, One Dalton Street
positioning: A modern 61-story tower in Boston's Back Bay with a Wellness Floor and a Zuma restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want a modern Back Bay base with a spa and pool
Guests who want Japanese izakaya dining on site

facts.text: The hotel is located at 1 Dalton Street in Boston's Back Bay neighborhood.
Zuma, a Japanese izakaya-inspired restaurant, is on the second floor.
Trifecta is a lobby lounge offering creative cocktails.
One + One serves breakfast and weekend brunch.
The Wellness Floor is on the entire 7th floor.
The hotel has a 64-foot curved swimming pool.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours.

highlights.text: The Deluxe Room has floor-to-ceiling views of Boston's Back Bay.
The Charles Suite is the hotel's only accommodation with a wrap-around terrace.
The Presidential Suite has curved floor-to-ceiling windows with city views toward Fenway Park.
Trifecta Afternoon Tea is served on Saturdays and Sundays.
The hotel's Canada Goose Lending Program offers jackets on loan during your stay.

considerations.text: Spa treatments are available Monday to Friday from 11:00 am to 7:00 pm.
The spa has five treatment rooms.
The tower also contains 160 private residences.
WhataHotel notes the high-rise tower setting may feel less intimate than boutique properties.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
